title: Nepal opens first modern road tunnel built with Japanese support - Myanmar International TV
description: Nepal opens first modern road tunnel built with Japanese support  Myanmar International TV
publisher.title: Myanmar International TV
full_article:
Nepal has inaugurated the Nagdhunga–Sisnekhola tunnel, the country's first modern road tunnel, built with assistance from Japan.

The 2,688-meter tunnel was opened by Minister for Infrastructure Development Sunil Lamsal and Japanese Ambassador to Nepal Maeda Toru. The tunnel is expected to reduce travel time, improve road connectivity and safety, including lowering the risk of landslides along the route. The project has also raised concerns in a nearby village over water shortages and damage to some homes linked to its construction.

title: 9,447 foreign tourists entered Nepal through Kakarbhitta in last fiscal year - Khabarhub
description: 9,447 foreign tourists entered Nepal through Kakarbhitta in last fiscal year  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
BHADRAPUR: A total of 9,447 foreign tourists entered Nepal through the eastern border point of Kakarbhitta in Jhapa, during the fiscal year 2082/83.

According to Indra Kumar Rajbanshi, acting chief of the Immigration Office, Kakarbhitta, an average of 26 foreign tourists entered Nepal through the border point each day during the period. As Indian citizens do not require visas to enter Nepal, Indian tourists are not included in the figure.

Citizens of 86 countries traveled through the Kakarbhitta border point, with Bhutanese nationals accounting for the largest share of arrivals. A total of 4,994 Bhutanese tourists entered Nepal, representing 53 percent of all foreign arrivals. Citizens of the United States were the second-largest group, with 2,152 arrivals, or 23 percent of the total, Rajbanshi said.

According to office statistics, Poush and Magh are considered the peak tourist months at the eastern border point. The highest number of tourists entered Nepal in Poush, with 1,850 arrivals, while the lowest number was recorded in Bhadra, with 216 arrivals.

Rajbanshi said the increase in arrivals during Poush and Magh is mainly due to winter holidays in Bhutan, during which many Bhutanese citizens visit relatives in Jhapa and surrounding areas and travel to Halesi Mahadev in Khotang, which is popularly known as the Pashupatinath of the East.

The Immigration Office has been providing full immigration services through the Kankarbhitta border crossing only since August 2024. The office stated that many foreign tourists are still not sufficiently informed about the availability of services through this entry point.

Heavy rainfall is likely at one or two places in the hilly regions of five provinces on Tuesday as the monsoon system continues to affect the entire country, the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology said.

Light to moderate rain accompanied by thunder and lightning is forecast at many places across the country's hilly regions. The mountainous regions may receive light to moderate rain and snowfall at a few places during the day, according to the department's 24-hour forecast issued at 8 am.

The department said the monsoon trough is currently near its normal position over eastern Nepal but lies north of its usual position over the western part of the country.

Rain expected in Kathmandu and Pokhara

Kathmandu is likely to experience moderate rain with thundershowers during both the day and night. The maximum temperature in the Valley is expected to remain between 28 and 30 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature may range from 19 to 21 degrees Celsius.

Pokhara is also forecast to receive moderate rain and thundershowers throughout the day and night, with a 70 per cent chance of rainfall during both periods. Temperatures are expected to range from 31 to 33 degrees Celsius during the day and 22 to 24 degrees Celsius at night.

Moderate rain and thundershowers are also likely in Dadeldhura, Nepalgunj, Ghorahi, Okhaldhunga, Jomsom, Jiri and Taplejung.

Meanwhile, light rain and thundershowers are forecast in several other major cities, including Dhangadi, Birendranagar, Bhairahawa, Simara, Biratnagar, Dharan and Janakpur.

The department said generally cloudy conditions are expected across the country's hilly and mountainous regions, while parts of the southern plains are likely to remain partly cloudy.

title: Nepal Medical Association announces nationwide halt to non-emergency services - Khabarhub
description: Nepal Medical Association announces nationwide halt to non-emergency services  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: The Nepal Medical Association (NMA) has announced a nationwide suspension of all non-emergency health services at government, public and private hospitals on Tuesday in protest against an alleged assault on doctors and health workers in Birgunj.

In a statement issued on Monday evening, the NMA said the protest was prompted by a violent attack on medical personnel at Narayani Hospital and the alleged mistreatment of its representatives at the District Administration Office in Parsa.

The Association said that on Saturday, Dr. Pramod Ram and other doctors and health workers at Narayani Hospital were assaulted, leaving some with serious head injuries.

It further alleged that while seeking legal action against those involved in the attack and vandalism at the hospital, members of the Association were verbally abused during talks at the District Administration Office in the presence of the Chief District Officer. The NMA also accused the Parsa police chief of deploying police personnel to intimidate and mistreat its representatives, including a central executive committee member and the president of its Narayani branch.

The NMA has demanded legal action against those responsible for the attack on healthcare workers and the vandalism at the hospital.

Apologizing for the inconvenience caused to patients, the Association said the government would bear full responsibility for the disruption in services.

KATHMANDU, JULY 28

Most hospitals across the country suspended non-emergency services on Tuesday after the Nepal Medical Association (NMA) launched a nationwide protest over the assault on doctors and health workers at Narayani Hospital in Birgunj.

Government, private and non-government hospitals halted regular outpatient and other non-emergency services, while emergency services remained operational. The protest has affected patients seeking routine consultations, follow-up treatment and other medical care.

At Civil Service Hospital, Bir Hospital and Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital in Kathmandu, emergency services continued, but the suspension of regular services led to increased pressure on emergency departments. Several patients were reportedly forced to return without receiving treatment, while others sought care through emergency units.

title: Nepal opens first road tunnel after more than six years of construction - The Star
description: Nepal opens first road tunnel after more than six years of construction  The Star
publisher.title: The Star
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Nepal officially inaugurated its first modern road tunnel on Monday, marking a major milestone in the country's transport infrastructure after more than six years of construction.

The Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola Tunnel was inaugurated by Infrastructure Development Minister Sunil Lamsal, alongside Japanese Ambassador Maeda Toru and Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) President Tanaka Akihiko.

The tunnel will initially be open only to emergency vehicles, with ambulances, fire engines and security vehicles granted access on the first day of operations, according to Nagdhunga Tunnel Construction Project director Saujanya Nepal.

Authorities have set toll charges for vehicles using the tunnel. Pedestrians, motorcycles, three-wheelers and non-motorised vehicles are prohibited from entering.

Vehicles carrying highly flammable materials, including diesel, petrol and gas, as well as explosives, are also banned for safety reasons.

To support electronic toll collection, authorities have introduced N-Tags using radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology. The tags are currently available with prepaid values of Rs1,000, Rs2,000 and Rs5,000.

The tunnel will be operated and managed by the Yusin-ART Joint Venture for the next five years, while Japan's Hazama Ando Corporation will oversee maintenance during the first year under a separate agreement.

The project was financed through approximately Rs21.5 billion in concessional loans from Japan, with an additional Rs6 billion contributed by the Nepal government.

The Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola Tunnel enters service 80 months after construction began, becoming Nepal's first operational road tunnel and a landmark project in the country's transport network. - Kathmandu Post

title: Nepal's Shinta Mani Mustang crowned world's best luxury hotel - Everest Chronicle
description: Nepal's Shinta Mani Mustang crowned world's best luxury hotel  Everest Chronicle
publisher.title: Everest Chronicle
full_article:
For decades, Nepal has sold itself to the world through snow peaks, trekking trails and mountaineering exploits. Now it has another claim to international attention: the world's top luxury hotel.

Shinta Mani Mustang, a 29-room retreat in the windswept Kali Gandaki Valley, has been ranked the world's No. 1 hotel in Robb Report's 50 Greatest Luxury Hotels on Earth 2026, surpassing some of the most celebrated names in global hospitality and signalling Nepal's growing credentials as an upscale travel destination.

The annual ranking, compiled by Robb Report's panel of 24 Travel Masters — advisers to some of the world's wealthiest travellers — is regarded as one of the industry's most influential assessments of luxury hospitality.

The magazine praised the hotel, designed by the architect Bill Bensley, as "another of maximalist designer Bill Bensley's masterful far-flung palaces of fantasy", calling it "the ultimate retreat for the body, mind and spirit" with sweeping Himalayan views.

The recognition places Nepal alongside destinations more commonly associated with high-end tourism, reflecting a broader shift in the country's image from a haven for backpackers and climbers to one capable of attracting affluent travellers seeking exclusivity, wellness and cultural immersion.

"This recognition is about far more than one hotel," said Namgyal Sherpa, chief executive of Sherpa Hospitality Group, which operates the property.

"For many years, our vision has been to reaffirm Nepal's place among the world's leading luxury destinations — not by changing who we are, but by celebrating what makes Nepal truly exceptional."

He said Nepal's landscapes, culture and heritage offered a distinctive luxury proposition at a time when travellers increasingly sought authentic experiences rather than conventional opulence.

Opened in August 2023 in Lower Mustang, Shinta Mani Mustang has rapidly accumulated international accolades. It was listed among the world's best luxury hotels in 2024 and won a Best Luxury Adventure Hotel award in 2025 before securing the top position this year.

According to Robb Report, guests are drawn not only by the property's contemporary design but also by experiences rooted in Mustang's ancient culture, including horseback expeditions, visits to centuries-old Buddhist settlements, trekking across high-altitude desert landscapes and traditional Tibetan healing therapies.

Among the hotels it outperformed were Rwanda's Singita Kwitonda, Scotland's Hope Lodge, Japan's Park Hyatt Tokyo and India's Shakti Prana.

The Nepal Tourism Board welcomed the accolade, describing it as evidence that the country can compete at the highest level of international hospitality while broadening its appeal beyond mountaineering and adventure tourism.

For a country long defined by Everest, the recognition suggests that luxury, too, may become part of Nepal's global identity.

दशकों स नेपाल बर्फ के चोटी, ट्रेकिंग ट्रेल आ पर्वतारोहण के कारनामा के माध्यम स अपना के दुनिया के बेचैत रहल अछि। आब एकर एकटा आओर दावा अछि जे अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर ध्यान देल गेल अछि : दुनिया क शीर्ष लग्जरी होटल ।

हवा स॑ घेरलऽ काली गंडकी घाटी म॑ २९ कमरा वाला रिट्रीट शिंता मणि मस्टैंग क॑ रॉब रिपोर्ट केरऽ ५० ग्रेटेस्ट लग्जरी होटल्स ऑन अर्थ २०२६ म॑ दुनिया केरऽ नंबर १ होटल के रूप म॑ दर्ज करलऽ गेलऽ छै, जे वैश्विक आतिथ्य केरऽ कुछ सबसें प्रसिद्ध नामऽ क॑ पछाड़ी म॑ छोड़ी क॑ नेपाल केरऽ एगो अपस्केल यात्रा गंतव्य के रूप म॑ बढ़त॑ जाय रहलऽ साख के संकेत दै छै ।

रॉब रिपोर्ट केरऽ 24 ट्रैवल मास्टर्स केरऽ पैनल द्वारा संकलित ई वार्षिक रैंकिंग - जे दुनिया केरऽ कुछ सबसें धनी यात्री सिनी के सलाहकार छै - क॑ लग्जरी आतिथ्य केरऽ उद्योग केरऽ सबस॑ प्रभावशाली आकलन म॑ स॑ एक मानलऽ जाय छै ।

पत्रिका न॑ आर्किटेक्ट बिल बेंसले द्वारा डिजाइन करलऽ गेलऽ होटल केरऽ प्रशंसा करलकै कि “मैक्सिमलिस्ट डिजाइनर बिल बेंसले केरऽ फैंटेसी केरऽ एगो आरू निपुण दूर-दूर केरऽ महल” के रूप म॑, एकरा व्यापक हिमालय केरऽ दृश्य के साथ “शरीर, मन आरू आत्मा लेली अंतिम रिट्रीट” कहलकै ।

ई मान्यता नेपाल क॑ उच्च श्रेणी के पर्यटन स॑ अधिक रूप स॑ जुड़लऽ गंतव्यऽ के साथ-साथ रखै छै, जे देश केरऽ छवि म॑ बैकपैकर आरू पर्वतारोही लेली ठिकाना स॑ व्यापक बदलाव क॑ दर्शाबै छै, जेकरा स॑ विशिष्टता, कल्याण आरू सांस्कृतिक विसर्जन चाहै वाला सम्पन्न यात्री सिनी क॑ आकर्षित करै म॑ सक्षम छै ।

संपत्ति संचालित करय वाला शेर्पा हॉस्पिटैलिटी ग्रुप के मुख्य कार्यकारी नामग्याल शेर्पा कहलनि जे, ई मान्यता एक सं कहीं बेसी होटल के बारे मे अछि।

"कई साल स॑ हमरऽ विजन ई रहलऽ छै कि दुनिया केरऽ प्रमुख लग्जरी गंतव्यऽ म॑ नेपाल केरऽ स्थान क॑ दोबारा पुष्टि करलऽ जाय — हम्मं॑ के छियै ओकरा बदली क॑ नै, बल्कि ई जश्न मनाबै के कि नेपाल क॑ सही मायने म॑ असाधारण बनाबै छै ।"

ओ कहलनि जे, नेपालक परिदृश्य, संस्कृति आ धरोहर ओहि समय मे एकटा विशिष्ट विलासिता प्रस्ताव पेश करैत अछि जखन यात्री लोकनि पारंपरिक ऐश्वर्य सं बेसी प्रामाणिक अनुभवक खोज मे तेजी सं जा रहल छलाह.

अगस्त २०२३ म॑ लोअर मस्टैंग म॑ खुललऽ शिंता मणि मस्टैंग न॑ तेजी स॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रशंसा जमा करी लेल॑ छै । ई 2024 म॑ दुनिया केरऽ सर्वश्रेष्ठ लग्जरी होटलऽ म॑ शामिल करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै आरू ई साल शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त करै स॑ पहल॑ २०२५ म॑ सर्वश्रेष्ठ लग्जरी एडवेंचर होटल केरऽ पुरस्कार जीतलऽ छेलै ।

रॉब रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, मेहमान न सिर्फ संपत्ति के समकालीन डिजाइन स॑ ही आकर्षित होय जाय छै बल्कि मस्टैंग केरऽ प्राचीन संस्कृति म॑ जड़ जमाय वाला अनुभव स॑ भी आकर्षित होय छै, जेकरा म॑ घोड़ा प॑ सवार होय के अभियान, सदियो स॑ पुरानऽ बौद्ध बस्ती के दौरा, उच्च ऊंचाई वाला रेगिस्तानी परिदृश्य के पार ट्रेकिंग आरू पारंपरिक तिब्बती चिकित्सा चिकित्सा शामिल छै ।

title: Election Commissioner Nominee Wagley Presents 5 Models for Overseas Nepali Voting - Ratopati
description: Election Commissioner Nominee Wagley Presents 5 Models for Overseas Nepali Voting  Ratopati

full_article:
Kathmandu. Proposed Election Commissioner Guru Prasad Wagle has presented 5 models in the parliamentary hearing committee that can be used to involve Nepali citizens living abroad in the upcoming elections.

Presenting his action plan in the parliamentary hearing committee ongoing in Singh Durbar, Wagle discussed 5 major election models prevalent in various countries around the world.

These are the models presented by Wagle

Ballot Box Based Model

Wagle has written in his action plan that voting will be conducted by establishing polling stations at Nepali embassies or designated diplomatic missions abroad and using physical ballot papers and ballot boxes. Wagle mentioned that this method is considered technically easy and reliable and is currently used by countries like Brazil, France, and Mexico.

Postal Voting

Wagle's second option is to arrange for voters to receive ballot papers through the post and send them back through the same medium. Wagle believes this method will be effective in reaching scattered voters in many places at a low cost. Wagle mentioned that this model has been successful in countries like Australia, Canada, and Germany.

Proxy Voting

In this method, voters living abroad appoint a person residing in Nepal to vote on their behalf. Wagle mentioned that this method is adopted under certain conditions in countries like the UK and Netherlands. However, Wagle warned of the risk of misuse.

Internet Voting

Wagle has mentioned that this is the most modern and technology-friendly model. Voters can cast their votes securely through the internet from any corner of the world. Wagle's action plan states that Estonia, Switzerland, and the Philippines are practicing this, and for its feasibility in Nepal, a data center and technology with high security will be required.

Mixed Model Also Read Proposed Commissioner Wagle's Action Plan to Make Elections Technology-Friendly and Grant Voting Rights to Nepalis Living Abroad

Wagle stated that the mixed model involves using two or more of the above methods simultaneously according to the convenience of the voters and geographical conditions. Wagle said that Australia and Denmark have adopted such flexible arrangements.

Proposed Commissioner Wagle has suggested moving forward in a 'phased' manner in the context of Nepal.

मिश्रित मॉडल सेहो पढू प्रस्तावित आयुक्त वागले के चुनाव प्रौद्योगिकी-अनुकूल बनेबाक आ विदेश मे रहय वाला नेपाली के मतदान के अधिकार देबय के कार्य योजना

description: Nepal relaxes Indian currency norms, allows Rs 200 and Rs 500 notes up to Rs 25,000  Firstpost
publisher.title: Firstpost
full_article:
If you are planning a trip to Nepal, carrying cash just got simpler.

In a move that will come as a relief to Indian travellers, Nepal has relaxed its rules on Indian currency, allowing visitors to carry higher denomination notes within a defined limit. The change is expected to make everyday transactions smoother, especially in tourist areas.

What has changed?

Nepal now permits individuals to carry Indian currency notes of Rs 200 and Rs 500 denominations up to a total value of Rs 25,000 per person. The rule applies to both Indian and Nepali citizens.

There is, however, one key condition. Only banknotes issued after 9 November 2016 are allowed. This means the newer series introduced after India’s demonetisation is valid, while older notes remain restricted.

STORY CONTINUES BELOW THIS AD

Why this matters?

Until recently, Indian travellers were largely restricted to carrying smaller denomination notes, making routine payments surprisingly inconvenient.

For instance, paying for a hotel stay, transport or a guided tour often required exact change or a visit to a currency exchange counter. The new rule reduces that friction by allowing commonly used denominations, making everyday spending far easier.

Indian currency is widely accepted in border towns and major tourist hubs such as Kathmandu and Pokhara, although smaller establishments may still prefer Nepali rupees.

What is still not allowed?

The relaxation does not extend to older currency. Pre-2016 high-value Indian notes, including the old Rs 500 and Rs 1,000, are still not permitted in Nepal.

Travellers carrying such notes may face inconvenience at entry points or while making payments, so it is important to check your cash before travelling.

Acceptance is not universal

While the rule makes travel more convenient, acceptance of Indian currency is not uniform across the country. Smaller vendors, local markets and remote areas may still prefer transactions in Nepali rupees.

Digital payments are gradually growing in Nepal, but coverage can be inconsistent, particularly outside major cities. Carrying a mix of payment options remains the safest approach.

उपयोगी नगद पर कम प्रतिबंध रहला स नेपाल मे खर्च बेसी सोझ आ कम तनावपूर्ण भ जाइत अछि।

भारतीय यात्री लेली ई बदलाव एगो लंबा समय स॑ चलै वाला असुविधा क॑ दूर करी क॑ सीमा पार स॑ अधिक निर्बाध यात्रा के अनुभव के संकेत दै छै ।

title: The geography of ambition on Mt Everest - Nepali Times
description: The geography of ambition on Mt Everest  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
I am writing this in Nepal, but I carry the topography of Bangladesh in my bones -- a land of floodplains and rivers, an unrelenting flatness where the horizon is a soft line between water and sky.

Life there is dictated by horizontality, by the flow of currents across vast plains. To come from that world and stand before the vertiginous geometry of the Himalayas is a sensory shock.

The mountains here are not just scenery; they are profound, overwhelming presences.

The news of Andrzej Bargiel’s feat -- climbing Mount Everest and skiing down from the summit to Base Camp without supplementary oxygen -- is not a distant headline, but an echo in a sacred valley, a concept almost alien to my native sense of space.

It is an almost unimaginable act, a blend of supreme athleticism and pure, terrifying audacity.

To picture him arcing turns in the Death Zone, where the body consumes itself and the mind frays, is to witness a form of human expression bordering on the sublime and the suicidal.

It forces a question that has haunted me since I first gazed upon these peaks from my horizontal world: Why? What alchemy of spirit drives a person to seek such a perilous, vertical edge?

To understand, we must look beyond the ice and rock. In his seminal work Mountains of the Mind, Robert Macfarlane says that mountains were once reviled as ‘monstrous excrescences of nature.’

The modern desire to conquer them is not innate but constructed, a product of shifting cultural tides -- Romanticism, the advent of geology, and the colonial impulse to map the unknown.

Bargiel’s descent is the logical, extreme endpoint of this centuries-long project. He is not just climbing a mountain; he is performing an idea forged in the West, the idea of the peak as the ultimate arena for self-testing. Macfarlane argues that this is a ‘history of the imagination’, and on Everest imagination meets its absolute physical limit.

Yet, to stand in Nepal is to feel a dissonance. The Western narrative often centres on the solitary hero, the individual will pitted against the elemental force. Here, all that crumbles like old moraine. The undeniable truth is that no Bargiel, no Messner, no Western climber can perform their feats without the Sherpa people.

BEDROCK

Their role is the bedrock upon which all Himalayan ambition is built. They are the engineers of the possible, stringing the safety lines over gaping crevasses, bearing the burdens, and possessing a profound, ancestral knowledge of these mountains that no satellite map can replicate.

This brings us to the uncomfortable machinery behind the mystique. A feat like Bargiel’s, while personally astounding, does not occur in a financial vacuum. It is underwritten by corporate sponsorship, a fact we must confront. The logo of an energy drink giant is the silent partner in this dance with death.

This is the commodification of human endurance, where extreme courage becomes a vehicle for brand narrative. The mountain, once a sublime terror, is now also a backdrop for a commercial. This sponsorship is what transforms a personal dream into a logistically feasible mission, creating a stark divide between the funded explorer and the local for whom the mountain is simply home.

It begs the question: What are we truly celebrating? The human spirit, or its successful corporate branding?

So, we are left with a complex portrait. The Western adventurer, armed with a historically cultivated obsession and corporate capital, comes to a land where the mountains are woven into the spiritual and daily life. He relies on the unparalleled skill and strength of the Sherpa, whose names are too often relegated to the fine print of history, to achieve a personal zenith.

The feat itself is a breathtaking, legitimate human achievement, a push against a boundary that redefines what is possible. But it is also a symbol of a profound asymmetry.

Perhaps the meaning lies in holding both these truths at once. We can, and should, stand in awe of Andrzej Bargiel’s incredible ski down the roof of the world. The footage of his descent is a cinematic poem of human focus and grace under the most extreme duress.

Simultaneously, we must use that awe to look deeper, to see the entire ecosystem of the feat -- the cultural history that propels it, the local labour that enables it, and the corporate engines that fund it.

The true summit, then, may not be a point on a map, but a point of understanding. As the mist swirls around the peaks outside my window, the mountains remain, immutable and silent. They care nothing for our sponsorships, our historical obsessions, or our records. They simply are.

The feats we perform upon them are ultimately stories we tell about ourselves -- our desires, our capacities, and our often-flawed relationships with the sacred, the wild, and each other.

Bargiel’s line down Everest is a visible, brilliant scar upon the slope. The more important line, the one we must all trace, is the unseen one between celebration and critique, between a conqueror and a guest.

ई बात हम नेपाल मे लिखि रहल छी, मुदा बांग्लादेशक स्थलाकृति केँ हड्डी मे ल' क' चलैत छी -- बाढ़िक मैदान आ नदीक भूमि, अदम्य समतलता जतय क्षितिज पानि आ आकाशक बीचक कोमल रेखा थिक.

ओतय के जीवन क्षैतिजता के द्वारा निर्धारित होइत अछि, विशाल मैदान के पार धारा के प्रवाह स। ओहि संसारसँ आबि हिमालयक चक्करदार ज्यामितिक सोझाँ ठाढ़ रहब संवेदी झटका थिक ।

एहि ठामक पहाड़ मात्र दृश्य नहिं थिक; ओ सभ गहींर, अभिभूत उपस्थिति थिक।

आंद्रेज बार्गीएल केरऽ कारनामा केरऽ खबर -- माउंट एवरेस्ट पर चढ़ना आरू बिना पूरक ऑक्सीजन केरऽ शिखर स॑ नीचें बेस कैंप तक स्कीइंग करना -- दूर केरऽ हेडलाइन नै, बल्कि पवित्र घाटी केरऽ प्रतिध्वनि छै, जे हमरऽ मूल अंतरिक्ष बोध लेली लगभग पराया अवधारणा छै ।

ई लगभग अकल्पनीय क्रिया छै, परम एथलेटिक्स आरू शुद्ध, भयावह दुस्साहस के मिश्रण छै ।

मृत्यु क्षेत्र में ओकरा चाप के मोड़ के चित्रण करना, जहाँ शरीर खुद के उपभोग करी लै छै आरू मन फीका होय जाय छै, उदात्त आरू आत्मघाती के सीमा में मानवीय अभिव्यक्ति के एक रूप के गवाह बनना छै ।

ई एकटा एहन प्रश्न के मजबूर करैत अछि जे हमरा तहिया स सता रहल अछि जहिया स हम अपन क्षैतिज दुनिया स एहि चोटी सब पर पहिल बेर तकलहुं अछि: किएक? आत्मा के कोन कीमिया व्यक्ति के एहन खतरनाक, ऊर्ध्वाधर किनारा तकय लेल प्रेरित करैत अछि?

बुझबाक लेल बर्फ आ चट्टानसँ आगू देखबाक चाही। रॉबर्ट मैकफार्लेन अपनऽ मौलिक कृति माउंटेन ऑफ द माइंड म॑ कहै छै कि एक समय म॑ पहाड़ऽ क॑ ‘प्रकृति केरऽ राक्षसी उत्सर्जन’ के रूप म॑ निंदा करलऽ जाय छेलै ।

ओकरा सब पर विजय प्राप्त करबाक आधुनिक इच्छा जन्मजात नहिं अपितु निर्मित अछि, बदलैत सांस्कृतिक ज्वार-भाटाक उपज -- रोमांटिकता, भूविज्ञानक आगमन, आ अज्ञातक नक्शा बनेबाक औपनिवेशिक आवेग.

बरगियल केरऽ वंश ई सदियो स॑ चलै वाला परियोजना केरऽ तार्किक, चरम अंतिम बिंदु छेकै । ओ खाली पहाड़ पर चढ़ि नहि रहल छथि; ओ पश्चिम में गढ़ल विचार के प्रदर्शन क रहल छथि, जे चोटी के आत्मपरीक्षण के अंतिम अखाड़ा के रूप में विचार अछि | मैकफार्लेन के तर्क छै कि ई ‘कल्पना के इतिहास’ छै, आरू एवरेस्ट पर कल्पना अपनऽ निरपेक्ष भौतिक सीमा के पूरा करै छै ।

तइयो नेपाल मे ठाढ़ रहब एकटा विसंगतिक अनुभूति करब थिक । पाश्चात्य कथ्य प्रायः एकांत नायक पर केंद्रित अछि, व्यक्ति तत्व शक्तिक विरुद्ध खड़ा होयत । एतय, ओ सबटा पुरान मोरेन जकाँ टुटि जाइत अछि। निर्विवाद सत्य ई छै कि शेर्पा लोगऽ के बिना कोय भी बरगियल, कोय मेसनर, कोय भी पाश्चात्य पर्वतारोही अपनऽ करतब नै करी सकै छै ।

बेडरोक

हुनकऽ भूमिका ही वू आधारशिला छेकै, जेकरा प॑ सब हिमालयी महत्वाकांक्षा के निर्माण होय छै । ई सब संभव के इंजीनियर छै, फाटलऽ दरारऽ पर सुरक्षा रेखा के तार लगाय क॑, बोझ उठाय क॑, आरू ई पहाड़ऽ के गहन, पैतृक ज्ञान के मालिक छै जेकरऽ नकल कोय उपग्रह नक्शा नै करी सकै छै ।

एहि सॅं रहस्यक पाछूक असहज मशीनरी दिस आबि जाइत छी । बरगियल’क सन करतब व्यक्तिगत रूप स’ आश्चर्यचकित करय बला रहितो आर्थिक वैक्यूम मे नहि होइत छैक. एकरऽ अंडरराइटिंग कॉरपोरेट प्रायोजन द्वारा करलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरऽ सामना हमरा सब क॑ करना चाहियऽ । एकटा एनर्जी ड्रिंक दिग्गज कंपनी के लोगो मौत के संग एहि नृत्य के मौन साथी अछि.

ई मानवीय सहनशक्ति केरऽ मालीकरण छेकै, जहां चरम साहस ब्रांड कथ्य केरऽ साधन बनी जाय छै । कहियो उदात्त आतंक रहल ई पहाड़ आब कोनो विज्ञापनक पृष्ठभूमि सेहो बनि गेल अछि । ई प्रायोजन ही छै जे व्यक्तिगत सपना क॑ लॉजिस्टिक रूप स॑ व्यवहार्य मिशन म॑ बदली दै छै, जेकरा स॑ वित्त पोषित अन्वेषक आरू स्थानीय के बीच एगो घोर विभाजन पैदा होय छै, जेकरा लेली ई पहाड़ बस घर छै ।

ई सवाल के भीख मांगै छै कि हम सही मायने में की मनाबै छियै? मानवीय भावना, या ओकर सफल कॉर्पोरेट ब्रांडिंग?

अस्तु, हमरा लोकनि एकटा जटिल चित्रक संग रहि गेल छी. ऐतिहासिक रूप स॑ खेती करलऽ गेलऽ जुनून आरू कॉरपोरेट पूंजी स॑ लैस पाश्चात्य साहसी एगो ऐन्हऽ भूमि प॑ पहुँचै छै, जहां पहाड़ आध्यात्मिक आरू दैनिक जीवन म॑ बुनलऽ जाय छै । व्यक्तिगत चरम पर पहुँचै लेली वू शेरपा केरऽ बेजोड़ कौशल आरू ताकत प॑ भरोसा करै छै, जेकरऽ नाम बहुत बार इतिहास केरऽ महीन छाप म॑ गिरी जाय छै ।

ई करतब स्वयं एकटा लुभावन, वैध मानवीय उपलब्धि अछि, एकटा एहन सीमाक विरुद्ध धक्का जे संभव के नव परिभाषित करैत अछि । मुदा ई एकटा गहींर विषमताक प्रतीक सेहो अछि ।

शायद एकर अर्थ एहि दुनू सत्य केँ एकहि संग पकड़बा मे अछि । हमरा लोकनि दुनियाक छत सं नीचा आंद्रेज बार्गीएलक अविश्वसनीय स्की देखि विस्मय सं ठाढ़ भ’ सकैत छी, आ ठाढ़ हेबाक चाही. हुनकऽ वंश केरऽ फुटेज सबसें चरम जबरदस्ती के तहत मानवीय फोकस आरू कृपा के सिनेमाई कविता छेकै ।

एकरऽ साथ-साथ, हमरा सिनी क॑ वू भय के उपयोग गहराई स॑ देखै लेली, करतब केरऽ पूरा पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र क॑ देखै लेली करना चाहियऽ -- एकरा आगू बढ़ाबै वाला सांस्कृतिक इतिहास, एकरा सक्षम करै वाला स्थानीय श्रम, आरू एकरा फंडिंग करै वाला कॉरपोरेट इंजन ।

तखन, असली शिखर नक्शा पर कोनो बिन्दु नहिं, बुझबाक बिन्दु भ सकैत अछि. जेना-जेना धुंध हमर खिड़कीक बाहर चोटी सभक चारूकात घुमैत अछि, पहाड़ सभ अपरिवर्तनीय आ मौन बनल रहैत अछि । हुनका सब के हमर प्रायोजन, हमर ऐतिहासिक जुनून, या हमर रिकॉर्ड के कोनो परवाह नै छै। बस, ओ सभ छथि।

हम सब जे करतब ओकरा सब पर करैत छी से अंततः हम सब अपन बारे में कहैत छी -- हमर इच्छा, हमर क्षमता, आ पवित्र, जंगली, आ एक दोसरा के संग हमर प्रायः त्रुटिपूर्ण संबंध.

एवरेस्ट केरऽ नीचें बरगियल केरऽ लाइन ढलान पर एगो दिखाई दै वाला, चमकदार निशान छै । जे रेखा बेसी महत्वपूर्ण अछि, जकर पता हमरा सभ केँ करबाक चाही, से अछि उत्सव आ आलोचनाक बीच, विजेता आ अतिथिक बीचक अनदेखल रेखा।

description: Securities Board of Nepal to Abandon Dual IGIN System  Ratopati

full_article:
Kathmandu. The Securities Board of Nepal is to back down from the dual IGIN system. About a year ago, to make Nepal's capital market organized, CDS & Clearing Limited (CDSC) brought a new directive, 'Securities Dematerialization Operation Directive-2082'.

In the said directive, CDSC has made a provision to provide separate international identification numbers (IGIN) for promoter and ordinary shares. However, the work procedure remained stuck at the board for a year.

The then Board Chairman Santosh Narayan Shrestha did not advance the said work procedure. But now, the new Chairman of the Board, Gopal Bhatta, has taken charge. Chairman Bhatta is preparing to study all the files that have been stuck and delayed in the past and move them forward.

However, there are indications that the provision in the 'Securities Dematerialization Operation Directive-2082' to provide separate IGINs for promoter and ordinary shares will be removed.

Board Chairman Bhatta gave such indications in a meeting with journalists a few days ago. He clearly indicated that the dual IGIN work procedure sent by CDSC a year ago would not be advanced.

According to Chairman Bhatta, the dual IGIN number is like an international passport for securities, so it cannot be manipulated arbitrarily. He said that the concept of dual IGIN is not in international practice. He mentioned that since the work procedure was made based on the guidelines of the international organization ANNA, it is not mandatory to implement it.

Chairman Bhatta said, 'The dual IGIN number is not our internal product, it is an international product. We have to follow the ANNA standard operating guideline. The concept of dual IGIN is not in international practice. The board is not in favor of implementing dual IGIN by going beyond international practice.'

He further clarified, 'Just as passport rules are the same all over the world, IGIN rules are also global. We cannot proceed by violating international standards. We will proceed according to international practice.'

Along with this, it seems certain that the dual IGIN work procedure, which CDSC has been proposing for a long time, will not be approved by the board.

Commenting on the work procedure sent by CDSC, he questioned, 'How has the work been going on without a work procedure so far? Why is a work procedure needed now?'

The IGIN number is issued by CDSC in coordination with the Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE). Only after CDSC issues the IGIN number, the shares issued by any company come into the shareholder's account. An IGIN number is required for shares obtained through IPO to come into the investor's demat account.

CDSC had sent the directive, passed by the board meeting on Shrawan 11 last year, to the Securities Board of Nepal for approval a year ago.

However, the 'Securities Dematerialization Operation Directive-2082' sent by CDSC to the board has not been approved yet. The directive, unanimously passed by the CDSC board meeting and sent to the Securities Board, was kept pending, stating that it was under study at the board.

After a long discussion and as per the instructions of the Securities Board, CDSC had prepared a work procedure regarding the International Security Identification Number (IGIN) provided during the dematerialization of securities and sent it to the board for approval.

This is CDSC's proposal in the directive

CDSC believes that the new directive will completely stop opaque practices in the capital market.

Now, if any company wants to convert promoter shares into ordinary shares, it will have to pass a decision from the general meeting, publish a public notice, and then request CDSC.

According to the directive, CDSC can merge IGINs as needed upon the request of a concerned institution. For this, the concerned institution will have to apply with documents and proof as follows.

The directive proposes to provide separate IGINs to companies that previously had a single IGIN number. Companies that previously had a single IGIN by merging promoter and ordinary shares will also get two IGINs after the directive is implemented.

Clause 7 (2) of the directive states, 'Securities of promoter and ordinary groups that were given a single IGIN before the implementation of this directive, including securities in the lock-in period, will be provided with separate IGINs after the implementation of the directive.'

Furthermore, if a security has been given a separate IGIN but is deemed unnecessary, CDSC has the provision to merge it.

CDSC has implemented a new system that allows merging and separating the International Identification Number (IGIN) provided for securities.

This new system by CDSC was expected to help make the dematerialized trading of the securities market more organized, transparent, and in line with international standards.

काठमांडू। नेपाल के प्रतिभूति बोर्ड के दोहरी आईजीआईएन प्रणाली स पाछू हटय के अछि। करीब एक साल पहिने नेपाल के पूंजी बाजार के संगठित बनेबाक लेल सीडीएस एंड क्लियरिंग लिमिटेड (सीडीएससी) एकटा नव निर्देश ‘सिक्योरिटीज डिमटेरियलाइजेशन ऑपरेशन डायरेक्टिव-2082’ अनलक।

उक्त निर्देश मे सीडीएससी प्रमोटर आ साधारण शेयरक कें लेल अलग-अलग अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पहचान संख्या (आईजीआईएन) उपलब्ध करावा कें प्रावधान करलक छै. मुदा, काजक प्रक्रिया एक साल धरि बोर्ड पर अटकल रहल।

तत्कालीन बोर्ड अध्यक्ष संतोष नारायण श्रेष्ठ उक्त कार्य प्रक्रिया के आगू नै बढ़ेलक। मुदा आब बोर्ड के नवका अध्यक्ष गोपाल भट्ट प्रभार संभालि लेलखिन्ह. अध्यक्ष भट्ट पहिने जे सब फाइल फंसल आ देरी भेल अछि ओकर अध्ययन क आगू बढ़ेबाक तैयारी मे छथि।

लेकिन संकेत छै कि ‘सिक्योरिटीज डिमटेरियलाइजेशन ऑपरेशन डायरेक्टिव-2082’ म॑ प्रमोटर आरू साधारण शेयरऽ लेली अलग-अलग आईजीआईएन उपलब्ध करै के प्रावधान हटाय देलऽ जैतै ।

बोर्ड अध्यक्ष भट्ट किछु दिन पहिने पत्रकार सब संग बैसार मे एहन संकेत देलनि। ओ साफ संकेत देलनि जे एक साल पहिने सीडीएससी द्वारा भेजल गेल ड्यूल आईजीआईएन वर्क प्रोसीजर एडवांस नहि होएत।

अध्यक्ष भट्ट क अनुसार ड्यूल आईजीआईएन नंबर प्रतिभूति क लेल अंतरराष्ट्रीय पासपोर्ट जेकां अछि, ताहि लेल एकरा मनमाना तरीका स हेरफेर नहि कैल जा सकैत अछि। ओ कहला जे ड्यूल आईजीआईएन क अवधारणा अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यवहार मे नहि अछि। हुनी उल्लेख करलकै कि चूंकि कार्य प्रक्रिया अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठन एन्ना के दिशा-निर्देश के आधार प बनलौ गेलौ छै, ई लेली एकरा लागू करना अनिवार्य नै छै ।

अध्यक्ष भट्ट कहलनि जे, 'ड्यूल आईजीआईएन नंबर हमर आंतरिक उत्पाद नहि अछि, इ अंतरराष्ट्रीय उत्पाद अछि। हमरा सब कए एएनए मानक संचालन दिशानिर्देश क पालन करय पड़त। ड्यूल आईजीआईएन केरऽ अवधारणा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यवहार म॑ नै छै । बोर्ड अंतरराष्ट्रीय अभ्यास स आगू बढ़ि कए ड्यूल आईजीआईएन लागू करबाक पक्ष मे नहि अछि।'

ओ आगू स्पष्ट केलनि जे, 'जहिना पासपोर्टक नियम पूरा दुनिया मे एके रंग अछि, तहिना आईजीआईएन नियम सेहो वैश्विक अछि।' हम अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक के उल्लंघन क आगू नहि बढ़ि सकैत छी। हम सब अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रथा क अनुसार आगू बढ़ब।'

एकरऽ साथ-साथ ई भी तय लगै छै कि सीडीएससी बहुत दिन स॑ प्रस्तावित ड्यूल आईजीआईएन वर्क प्रोसीजर क॑ बोर्ड स॑ मंजूरी नै मिलतै ।

सीडीएससी द्वारा भेजल गेल कार्य प्रक्रिया पर टिप्पणी करैत ओ सवाल उठेलथि जे एखन धरि बिना कार्य प्रक्रिया के काज कोना चलि रहल अछि? आब काजक प्रक्रियाक आवश्यकता किएक अछि?'

आईजीआईएन नम्बर नेपाल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज (नेप्से) के समन्वय मे सीडीएससी द्वारा जारी कएल गेल अछि । सीडीएससी कें आईजीआईएन नंबर जारी करय कें बाद ही कोनों कंपनी कें द्वारा जारी शेयर शेयरधारक कें खाता मे आबै छै. आईपीओ के माध्यम सं प्राप्त शेयर के निवेशक के डिमैट खाता मे आबय लेल आईजीआईएन नंबर के जरूरत अछि.

पिछला साल श्रावण 11 कए बोर्ड क बैसार स पारित निर्देश कए सीडीएससी एक साल पहिने नेपाल क प्रतिभूति बोर्ड कए मंजूरी लेल पठा देने छल।

लेकिन सीडीएससी द्वारा बोर्ड क॑ भेजलऽ गेलऽ ‘सिक्योरिटीज डिमटेरियलाइजेशन ऑपरेशन डायरेक्टिव-२०८२’ क॑ अखनी तलक मंजूरी नै मिललऽ छै । सीडीएससी बोर्ड केरऽ बैठक स॑ सर्वसम्मति स॑ पारित करी क॑ प्रतिभूति बोर्ड क॑ भेजलऽ गेलऽ ई निर्देश क॑ लंबित रखलऽ गेलै, जेकरा म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै कि एकरऽ अध्ययन बोर्ड म॑ चलैलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

लंबा चर्चा के बाद आरू प्रतिभूति बोर्ड के निर्देश के अनुसार सीडीएससी न॑ प्रतिभूति के विभौतिकीकरण के दौरान उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा पहचान संख्या (आईजीआईएन) के संबंध म॑ काम के प्रक्रिया तैयार करी क॑ ओकरा मंजूरी लेली बोर्ड क॑ भेजलकै ।

इ निर्देश मे सीडीएससी क प्रस्ताव अछि

सीडीएससी क मानब अछि जे एहि नव निर्देश स पूंजी बाजार मे अपारदर्शी प्रथा कए पूरा तरह स रोकल जाएत।

आब अगर कोनो कंपनी प्रमोटर शेयर के साधारण शेयर मे बदलय चाहय अछि तं ओकरा आम सभा सं फैसला पास करय पड़त, सार्वजनिक सूचना प्रकाशित करय पड़त, आओर फेर सीडीएससी सं आग्रह करय पड़त.

निर्देश कें अनुसार सीडीएससी कोनों संबंधित संस्था कें अनुरोध पर जरूरत कें अनुसार आईजीआईएन कें विलय कयर सकय छै. एकरा लेल संबंधित संस्था कए दस्तावेज आ प्रमाण क संग निम्नलिखित तरीका स आवेदन करय पड़त।

एहि निर्देश मे ओहि कंपनी कए अलग-अलग आईजीआईएन उपलब्ध करेबाक प्रस्ताव अछि, जेकर पहिने एकटा आईजीआईएन नंबर छल। जे कंपनी पहिने प्रमोटर आ साधारण शेयर कए मिला कए एकटा आईजीआईएन रखैत छल ओकरा सेहो एहि निर्देश लागू भेलाक बाद दूटा आईजीआईएन भेटत।

निर्देशक कें खंड 7 (2) मे कहल गेल छै, 'प्रमोटर आ साधारण समूहक कें प्रतिभूतियक कें जेकरा अइ निर्देश कें लागू करय सं पहिले एकटा आईजीआईएन देल गेलय छल, जइ मे लॉक-इन अवधि मे प्रतिभूतियक शामिल छै, निर्देश कें लागू करय कें बाद अलग-अलग आईजीआईएन उपलब्ध करायल जेतय.'

संगहि, यदि कोनों प्रतिभूति कें अलग सं आईजीआईएन देल गेल छै मुदा ओकरा अनावश्यक मानल गेल छै, त सीडीएससी कें पास ओकरा विलय करय कें प्रावधान छै.

सीडीएससी न॑ एगो नया सिस्टम लागू करलकै जेकरा स॑ प्रतिभूतियऽ लेली उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पहचान संख्या (आईजीआईएन) क॑ विलय आरू अलग करलऽ जाय सकै छै ।

सीडीएससी द्वारा ई नया प्रणाली स॑ प्रतिभूति बाजार केरऽ डिमटेरियलाइज्ड ट्रेडिंग क॑ अधिक संगठित, पारदर्शी आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुरूप बनाबै म॑ मदद मिलै के उम्मीद छेलै ।

If you’re planning a trip to Nepal, things are about to get easier. If you usually prefer carrying cash while travelling, here’s some good news. Nepal is now allowing certain Indian currency notes. So, before planning your trip, here’s the major update you should know!

Nepal Now Allows Indian Notes

In a recent update, Nepal announced that Indian and Nepalese nationals can now carry ₹200 and the redesigned ₹500 Indian currency notes. As per NDTV, before this decision, following India’s 2016 demonetisation, only Indian currency notes of up to ₹100 were allowed in the country.

The Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) reissued the notice on Thursday to explain the updated rules and clarify their implementation. However, these provisions had already been notified through the Nepal Gazette on February 11 after the required regulations were finalised. As per the new rules, travellers can carry ₹200 and ₹500 notes issued on or after November 9, 2016.

Also Read: No Ban On Indian Mango Imports In Nepal; 2,005 Metric Tonnes Exported Since Jan

How Much Cash Can You Carry To Nepal?

A person visiting Nepal can carry up to ₹25,000 in Indian currency, and this limit remains unchanged from the earlier rule. But there’s a catch. NDTV reported that NRB spokesperson Guru Prasad Paudel clarified a few important conditions. Nepalese citizens can bring Indian currency into Nepal only if they are travelling from India. They cannot bring Indian currency from any other country. Similarly, they cannot carry Indian currency from Nepal to a third country unless they are travelling to India.

If you’re carrying foreign currency, you can bring up to USD 5,000 into Nepal without declaring it to customs. If you’re carrying more than that, you must announce. For Indian currency, travellers can carry an amount equivalent to up to USD 5,000 without a customs declaration only if the notes are in denominations of ₹100 or lower. If the amount exceeds the USD 5,000 limit, a customs declaration becomes mandatory.

नेपाल आब भारतीय नोटक अनुमति

हाल के अपडेट में नेपाल घोषणा केलक जे भारतीय आ नेपाली नागरिक आब ₹200 आ नव डिजाइन कएल गेल ₹500 भारतीय मुद्रा नोट ल क जा सकैत अछि । एनडीटीवी के अनुसार एहि फैसला सं पहिने भारत के 2016 के विमुद्रीकरण के बाद देश मे सिर्फ ₹100 तक के भारतीय मुद्रा नोट के अनुमति छल.

नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक (एनआरबी) बृहस्पतिदिन पुनः सूचना जारी कए अद्यतन नियमक व्याख्या आ ओकर कार्यान्वयन पर स्पष्टीकरण केलक अछि । मुदा आवश्यक नियमावली के अंतिम रूप देला के बाद 11 फरवरी के नेपाल राजपत्र के माध्यम सं एहि प्रावधान के अधिसूचना भ चुकल छल. नबका नियम के अनुसार यात्री 9 नवंबर 2016 या ओकर बाद जारी ₹200 आ ₹500 के नोट ल क जा सकैत छथि।
